game.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut

items.text: Hey everyone!
We’ve released a new hotfix, version 1.1.0.1!

notes.title: Please see the patch notes below

items.text: Fixed an issue where the schedule "Work: Main Role in a Movie" repeats every week and could not be removed.
Fixed the relationship UI where the heart icons and the relationship bar visuals could become out of sync.
Fixed an issue where the highlight in the BBQ minigame could become skewed.
Fixed typo in Hana's Character Story 4.
Thank you for your continued support and for reporting issues to us! 💕
Wisageni and PQube
Hey everyone!
We have some exciting news for you as K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut has just dropped a new update!
This is our first major update since launch, and we’ve got some new features, improvements, and fixes to share with you.
One of the biggest changes in this update is an expansion to the number of save slots available.
Previously, you could have 3 save slots. With this update, that number has been increased to 12 save slots!
Even better, you can now save your game to any slot you choose, giving you much more freedom to manage your different playthroughs, groups and choices.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41485522/16b4ad7a54e2e8d2dff1c956228d7a1c0972be36.jpg"]
We’ve also added a brand-new Debut Gallery!
Your idols work hard to reach the stage, and now you can look back on their achievements. The Debut Gallery allows you to review your debut history and the groups you have created!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41485522/23cecc16518d1301c4c5ea413b377c3d44cb678b.png"]
We’ve also added new lightstick items, additional idol status in NG+, polished several cutscenes, and made a number of changes to improve the overall experience.
And this is only the beginning. We have plenty of other improvements and features currently in development in the future.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41485522/1297bc68bde312890a34ee75427c950b3d68388d.jpg"]
Expanding number of save slots from 3 to 12
Added feature to be able to save to any slot
Added Debut Gallery, allowing players to review their debut history
Feature: Additional idol status in NG+
User experience improvement for BBQ minigame when using a game controller
Added 9 new lightstick items: 5 cores, 4 heads
Visual update on character choices in Spotlight Falling Cutscene
Polished cutscenes: Eunha story 3, Joo Won's persuasion 7 at week 43, Yue ending (story 6), Taehyung story 3, and Gita story 6
Fixed a mismatch between the available characters in the interview and Offline Casting minigame.
Fixed Ai not being removed from the debut line-up in a branch of Ai's Character Story 5
Fixed Mr. Jae requesting current group leader to become leader again in week 33
Fixed narrative conflict and missing tutorial for Single Cover Design
Fixed narrative conflict when reaching game over without completing Single Debut Preparation
Fixed newly unlocked schedule UI overlapping tutorial lines
Fixed only Yue's childhood post being available on Instantgram when the storyline triggers

Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to leave feedback, comments, suggestions, and bug reports. We’re reading your feedback and using it to help improve the game, so please keep sharing your thoughts with us!
You can leave any feedback and report any issues you encounter from this new update in this feedback and reporting thread or in our Discord Server.
Wisageni and PQube

items.text: We’ve just released patch 1.0.8.4, which includes important fixes and improvements. See below for the full spoiler-free changelog:
Fixed an issue where the game could sometimes become stuck in Month 12.
Extended the debut deadline to Month 12, Week 3 (Week 47) when a trainee was injured in the Spotlight Accident, so there is no sudden game over.
Fixed a softlock that caused the UI to become unresponsive when receiving a trainee's phone call during Gita's Character Story 3.
Fixed a softlock that caused the UI to become unresponsive after playing Yuna's Character Story 2 and answering Joo Won's phone call in Month 5, Week 4.
Adjusted the consequence of one of the story choices in Month 9, Day 1 (Week 33) to for a fairer outcome.
Fixed an issue where Ai's 5th Character Story could be triggered before the group's debut.
Replaced the icon of Mr. Ji-hoon (TV Producer) in the Relationship List with Mr. Jin-Woo (Bar Owner) for better clarity.
Adjusted achievements rewards.
Fixed an issue where the Group Concept type could sometimes be set incorrectly when confirming the selection with right-clicking instead of left-clicking.
Moved the unlock timing of Single Cover Design to after the start of Single Preparation (Week 37).
Fixed the Single Cover Design save system. Previous cover design progress will now be saved properly.
Fixed missing narrative after Seohyeon is injured in the Spotlight accident.
Fixed the random choice chances when running schedules to reduce repeated choices.
Fixed Ending Letter references to untriggered character stories.
Fixed an issue where Mr. Jae asks the current group leader to become the leader again in Week 33.
Fixed a trainee not being eliminated after the player agrees to transfer them to Joo Won.
Fixed a display issue of the face icons used in Gita's Character Story 3.
Fixed incorrect text in the confirmation popup when changing a single's release date.
Fixed an incorrect Game Over message when going bankrupt after debut.
Fixed an issue where Joo Won could appear in the bankruptcy Game Over ending during Mr. Jae's route.
Added a recovery period after the Spotlight incident before the affected trainee returns to full health.
Fixed various issues related to the debut single release.
Fixed an issue where the button for incoming phone calls could sometimes be unresponsive to left clicking.
Fixed an issue where the phone call from Joo Won would sometimes be missed in his character story.
Updated the trainees' birthdays, blood types, and some salary values.
We’re continuing to work on additional fixes and improvements, with more updates planned for future patches. Our team is working hard to deliver these changes as soon as possible.
Thank you all for your continued feedback and support. We’re actively reviewing your reports and suggestions, which help us identify areas for improvement and shape future updates.
We’ve also created a new community feedback thread for this patch, where you can share your thoughts and report any issues you encounter.
Wisageni & PQube
Hey everyone,
Thank you so much for all your positivity, reports, and constructive feedback following the launch of K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut.

We've been reading through your comments and really appreciate everyone who has taken the time to share feedback with us. We know some players may have experienced issues affecting their progress, and we are actively investigating these. Thank you for your patience and understanding while we work through them. We'll continue to share updates as soon as we have more information.
In the meantime, we've released Version 1.0.7, which includes several fixes and improvements:
(Spoiler)Fixed missing dialogue explaining a potential game over after the Spotlight accident.
(Spoiler)Fixed a narrative inconsistency in the Spotlight accident when hiring bodyguards.
Increased success rate for the casting schedule.
Fixed Evaluation 3 money reward not being paid correctly.
Added loan inflows and outflows to reports to improve transparency of money flow.
Adjusted New Game+ reward calculations.
Fixed incorrect text being displayed in the Instantgram comment section in the Week 8 post.
Fixed a display issue with a CG in Joo Won's story ending.
Fixed UI scaling issues at 16:10 screen resolutions (Credits page and Gachapon minigame).
Minor fixes for text and UI behaviours.
Thank you again for your patience and support while we continue working through these issues. We really appreciate everyone who has taken the time to share with us. 🙏
Wisageni & PQube
Thank you so much for all your support! 💖✨
Whether it’s through wishlisting the game, joining and being active in our Discord server, or showing love with likes and reposts on social media.
Even when you leave reviews on the Steam demo page or fill out our feedback form, it truly means a lot!
Reading your thoughts and chatting with you has been a joy, and it all means the world to our small indie team.
Right now, K-pop Idol Stories has been selected as one of the Official Selections at BitSummit, Japan’s biggest indie game event.✨
The game also joining Dames 4 Games Summer Showcase as an alumni from July 18–25, 2025✨
[dynamiclink href="http://twitch.tv/Dames4Games"]
To celebrate, we’ll be showcasing our demo with Japanese language support at our booth at
Miyako Messe, Kyoto, Japan, from July 18–20, 2025. 🎉
For those who can’t attend in person, don’t worry...
We’re also updating the Steam demo! ☺️💖

This also means that the full version of the game will include Japanese language support at launch, along with support for other languages like Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Korean, and French.
🎮 ✨ Here are a few things included in the K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut Version 0.4.425 Demo update:
New: All White Costume.
New: Japanese language support.
Major UI adjustment.
New: trainees status graph.
New: Benefit difference between the 3 manager types.
Improved cutscenes and the animation.
More random events and interactions.
Improved data and preview in the Schedule tree UI.
Balancing and adjusting the difficulty in Audition mini games.
New and improved character's sitting pose.
New and improved shop items.
Increase the responsiveness in some mini games, especially the Vocal Rhythm mini game.
Balancing improvement in data management.
More informative input prompt display in some UIs.
Fix various game freeze, glitches and bugs.
Fix the issue with ultra wide screen resolution.
